ios.desc:
Your all-in-one fitness companion — powered by AI, built for results.

Liftor combines workout tracking, nutrition management, AI coaching, and mental wellness into one powerful app. Whether you train solo orwith a personal trainer, Liftor adapts to your goals and keeps you accountable.

  SMART WORKOUT TRACKING
  Log sets, reps, and weight with ease. Get automatic personal record detection and celebrate every milestone. Choose from 400+ exercises
  or let AI generate a custom program tailored to your goals.

  AI-POWERED COACHING
  Chat with your AI coach for personalized workout programs, meal plans, and progressive overload suggestions. It's like having a trainer
  in your pocket — available 24/7.

  NUTRITION MADE SIMPLE
  Scan your food with Food Vision AI to instantly log calories and macros. Track meals by day, set custom nutrition goals, and generate AI
  meal plans that fit your lifestyle.

  PROGRESS YOU CAN SEE
  Take progress photos and compare them side by side. Track body weight trends, build workout streaks, and watch your transformation unfold
   over time.

  MENTAL WELLNESS
  Stay balanced with guided breathing exercises, mood check-ins, and a personal journal. Because fitness is more than just physical.

  TRAINER & CLIENT PLATFORM
  Trainers can manage clients, assign workouts, and communicate directly through the app. Clients get structured programs and
  accountability — all in one place.

  DEEP APPLE INTEGRATION
  - Apple Watch app for workout tracking on your wrist
  - Home Screen widgets for streaks and quick start
  - Live Activities for rest timer on your lock screen
  - Apple Health sync for workouts, nutrition, and body weight

  KEY FEATURES
  - AI workout & meal plan generation
  - Food Vision AI scanner
  - 400+ exercise database
  - Rest timer with haptic feedback
  - Workout streaks & gamification
  - Progress photos with comparison
  - Body weight tracking
  - Trainer-client messaging
  - Pull-to-refresh & offline support
  - Dark mode

Download Liftor and start training smarter today.

quotes.text:
Hi guys,

I would like to share my new app with you. It is a app for fitness enthusiasts.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/flexor-fitness-companion/id6758482608

You can:
Track your workouts
Track your nutritions
Work on your mental health
Have AI coach in pocket

Connect with your client or trainer - Trainer can assign workouts, see what clients eat.. Clients can share progress photos with trainer...

App was build because I was missing connection between me and my trainer, all conversations was done using whatsapp and it was not as comfortable as it should be.
quotes.story_title: Published a fitness app to connect trainers and clients
